outcome: Organ dysfunction (cardiovascular, renal, central nervous system, respiratory, hepatic, and hematologic)
cohort: 100 consenting parturients with term gestation posted for elective cesarean section under single-shot subarachnoid block
finding: In non-laboring pregnant patients undergoing elective cesarean section, IAP is significantly higher in the supine position compared to the 10° left lateral position, but IAP in neither position is significantly associated with organ dysfunction.
